parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['sequence_name','emails'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const emails=Array.isArray(body.emails)?body.emails:[];if(emails.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'emails must be a non-empty array'}}];const seqTypes=['onboarding','nurture','sales_outreach','re_engagement','post_purchase','trial_conversion','event_followup','churn_prevention','upsell'];const seqType=seqTypes.includes(body.sequence_type)?body.sequence_type:'nurture';const formattedEmails=emails.slice(0,15).map((e,i)=>({position:i+1,subject:((e.subject||e.subject_line||'')).trim().slice(0,150),previewText:(e.preview_text||'').trim().slice(0,100),body:(e.body||e.content||'').trim().slice(0,1200),sendDelay:e.send_delay||'',goal:e.goal||'',openRate:parseFloat(e.open_rate)||null,clickRate:parseFloat(e.click_rate)||null,unsubscribeRate:parseFloat(e.unsubscribe_rate)||null,conversionRate:parseFloat(e.conversion_rate)||null}));return[{json:{valid:true,sequenceName:body.sequence_name.trim(),sequenceType:seqType,audienceDescription:(body.audience_description||'').slice(0,400),productName:(body.product_name||'').trim(),sequenceGoal:(body.sequence_goal||'').slice(0,300),brandVoice:(body.brand_voice||'').slice(0,200),currentPerformanceNotes:(body.current_performance_notes||'').slice(0,400),emails:formattedEmails,emailCount:formattedEmails.length,replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You optimize email sequences for SaaS and e-commerce companies. Good email sequences: have one clear goal per email, lead with value not asks, match the reader's mindset at that point in the journey, use subject lines that earn the open (not trick it), and build momentum across the sequence. You give specific rewrites, not vague advice. Always respond in valid JSON only.
